sales/sales-detail-direct.detail.spec.ts: Start logged-in as the tenant admin.
Fetch a real sales-order id from the API (salesOrders.list) so the test isn't dependent on the list view showing rows.
Navigate directly to /dashboard/sales/<id> (the refactored $id detail page).
Assert no ErrorBoundary / 'order not found' crash.
Assert real order content renders: the order number, the 'Total Amount' label, and 'Created By' (which reads order.createdByName — the field whose `as any` cast was removed).
Open the Cancel Sale dialog (extracted CancelSaleDialog), assert it shows, then Escape-close it — never submit, because cancelling a sale is irreversible.
